milestone: EB0.4 — GMGN Historical Market Data Feasibility & Birth-to-Peak Opportunity Reconstruction
production_protection: No services restarted; no EB0.3 deployment; no production configuration, queue, Evidence or acquisition changes; zero GMGN and zero Helius requests issued.

official_gmgn_docs.data_api: Official Q&A states that GMGN has no plan to open a general data API; it describes a possible IP whitelist for trading users.
official_gmgn_docs.trading_api: Official Cooperation API documents a permissioned trading API, API key header x-route-key, and one call per five seconds per key. It does not establish an accessible historical OHLCV/market-outcome API for this platform.
official_gmgn_docs.chart_embed: Official chart documentation supports an embeddable kline URL and interval presentation controls. It is not a documented structured historical-data extraction contract.

request_budget.reason: No legitimate configured or documented structured market-data access. Undocumented endpoint probing is not a feasibility test.

sample.reason: A frozen stratified sample would be misleading without an authorized endpoint or credentialed capability to query.

required_measurements_unavailable: earliest GMGN observation versus chain birth

design_if_access_is_later_authorized.source_role: GMGN may provide external market observations only; creator-to-mint identity remains platform-derived.
design_if_access_is_later_authorized.comparison_rule: Never label earliest GMGN candle as birth MC unless timing and semantics prove it. Use GMGN_EARLIEST_OBSERVED.
design_if_access_is_later_authorized.preferred_future_join: PumpPortal immutable first-seen MC plus GMGN future observed history, yielding first-seen actionable multiple without making GMGN creator authority.
design_if_access_is_later_authorized.staged_backfill: Only after a successful small credentialed sample: recent repeat creators, then >=10-launch creators, then EB0.2 validation cohorts.

verdicts.non_migrated_coverage: D — UNSUITABLE until a documented sample proves otherwise

next_gate: Obtain explicit GMGN data-access authorization and a documented structured endpoint contract. Then freeze a 30–50 mint stratified sample and execute a separately approved bounded request budget.
